rationales.1: The full finding arrives in the opening lede and again in the then-and-now panels, so the conclusion is reachable by reading alone with no interaction required.
rationales.2: The single chart is named and described by its actual finding, its calendar axis is untruncated, the missing years are drawn as shaded gaps and 2019 is left hollow.
rationales.3: Every required disclosure is present, but at 375 px the full-record table is clipped so the no-record reasons and the 2019 label survive only in the chart footnotes and the closing notes.
rationales.4: The two-ink conceit is written with care, though the two human quotes are parked in a section of their own rather than placed where they would serve the data.
rationales.5: Desktop typography is composed and the measure is comfortable, but the mobile full-record table is cut mid-word at the right edge and loses its last column.
rationales.6: The base page is fully readable and static in both modes, with nothing pacing the reader against their will.
rationales.7: Printed in two inks is one sentence that all four layers carry, though the ink makes the instrument change felt more than the seasonal shift itself.
rationales.8: One deliberate break, provenance rendered as color, is declared in a legend up front and the reading mechanics stay entirely conventional.
rationales.9: The local register is competent, though several passages read systemic rather than spoken, as in the difference ink to ink.
rationales.10: Every device, the ink pairing, the shaded bands and the hollow dot, maps to something the record actually carries.
